item.title: Agent Registry and inbound authentication: the allow-all Noop defaults, and the risk of treating one header as an identity
item.description: The registry and authentication layers of ADK Go v2.4.0: the agentregistry client (ADC plus mTLS endpoint selection, quota project precedence, the All* iterators, the RemoteAgent/MCPToolset factories and the cleanName identifier rules); the four inbound authn implementations (Noop/Header/IAP/Custom) and the 401 versus 500 split; the CanActAsUser semantics of authz with its Noop/Strict pair; which routes are Public; which controllers never reach an authorizer at all; and the outbound auth package with ConsentRequiredError and its logging prohibitions.
